items.title: PR009: preserve selected ChatGPT originals and complete node fidelity
items.body:
Implements ROADMAP-PR-009 from the supplied package (SHA-256 `13725a185515a5a409c80e60cc4046aeec01bbb774f87bae6125b51652d5ec14`) on current main `9fbadef2714fae92e516a80b52d29cb9824b0e44`.

- Capture selected regular ChatGPT JSON bytes once and retain exact originals, source versions, origins and extraction history in the existing Content Lab SQLite owner.
- Account for every observed mapping node and topology gap across branches, while preserving the legacy text/attachment IDs, immutable items and FTS.
- Reconcile absence only in conversations present in this selected export; retain unselected chat heads. Invalid captured JSON/schema produces an ERROR extraction without derived-head changes.
- Expose bounded inspection and hash-verified atomic original export via CLI; no Native/desktop IPC or network attachment retrieval.
- Include 18 synthetic raw fixtures and failure tests (SQLite rollback, process death, post-commit receipt repair, migration, tamper and original roundtrip).

Local validation: 256 Content Lab tests passed; 4 Native bridge test files, 11 extension test files and 8 qualification adapter tests passed; `git diff --check` passed. The sandboxed Python run had one loopback-socket permission error; the full suite passed with local loopback access.

The selected JSON parser retains its 64 MiB per-input guard, 100,000 total mapping-node guard and 64 MiB ledger guard. These do not impose a repository file-count cap. Installed Windows device qualification is not claimed. Capture-change fault injection and physical ENOSPC remain partial evidence. Exact-head Ubuntu/Windows CI is required before merge.

Implementation tree: `8864a469cfa8d20b4bfc7ad01c1dba81df0633f7`, verified byte-for-byte against the locally tested tree.
[Runbook](docs/automation/pr009-chatgpt-original-fidelity.md) · [20-case receipt](docs/automation/runs/PR009_IMPLEMENTATION_RESULT_2026-10-04.json).

items.title: PR007: verified JS/TS static relations from captured repository bytes
items.body:
Captured JS/TS files previously had text-only analysis and no syntax-derived references. This adds `repo_js.py`, a foreground read-only CLI that builds exact raw-byte declaration/import/re-export evidence and conservative manifest-only source relations without changing capture, Python groups or ZIP export.

- Vendored, SHA256-verified `@babel/parser 7.28.5` (MIT), private one-file subprocess protocol, clean environment, bounded frames/stderr/deadline and child cleanup.
- Validated PR005 eligibility contract, with explicit-only legacy guard for older captures; unknown/mismatched facts stay gaps. PR005/006 actual owners are absent from this base. JS `occ.repo-static-relation.v1` is not automatically joined to the Python planner.
- Exact case-sensitive relative source paths; TS runtime extensions, dynamic/CommonJS, aliases, assets and unsupported forms retain typed unresolved reasons. Type-only edges are separate; symbol binding remains NOT_TYPECHECKED.
- Streaming ordered JSONL, stable logical IDs and compact canonical digests, metadata/content proofs, private same-volume stage, kernel lock, atomic publication and verified identical reuse.
- No total file-count, elapsed-time or output-size ceiling by default. Per-file AST resource budgets preserve captured bytes with an explicit fallback; physical disk/RAM/time limits remain.
- Windows installer includes the offline trusted parser layout.

Validation on the exact local tree:
- Content Lab: **273 tests passed**.
- Bridge: **46 passed**; qualification adapter: **8 passed**; extension: **112 passed**.
- Actual AST corpus: **200 cases / 20 families**, all 171 refs and declaration spans match labels; **67 true positives, 0 false positives, 0 false negatives**; precision/recall 1.0, **20/20 dynamic unresolved**. Synthetic bootstrap; independent holdout not provided.
- Actual Git→SQLite scale fixture: **2,001 files / 2,000 exact edges**, 103.719s, observed parent+child peak 72,855,552 bytes, unchanged raw ledger; explicit legacy guard. This is Linux synthetic-source qualification, not Dell Windows device evidence.
- Process fault/cancel/deadline/ENOSPC, before/after publish crash, second-process lock, corrupt stage/reuse, scope/profile and installed-isolated-load checks. PR002 manifest and actual PR003 ZIP hashes match before/after analysis.
- `git diff --cached --check` passed; GitHub tree equals tested local tree `29b99cc3124457d99a413f8fcc054045170b72dd`.

[Usage and limits](https://github.com/BobIvans/scaling-chrome-extensions/blob/codex/pr007-js-ts-static-relations/docs/automation/roadmap-pr007-js-ts-relations.md) · [Scoped implementation receipt](https://github.com/BobIvans/scaling-chrome-extensions/blob/codex/pr007-js-ts-static-relations/docs/automation/roadmap-pr007-implementation-result.json)

Exact-head Ubuntu/Windows CI must pass before merge. Dell Windows11/16GB 10k-file/UI/2workers qualification, real-world holdout, compiler-mode/CJS/workspace resolver, AST checkpoint/cache resume and mixed/planner/UI consumers remain follow-ups; whole LAYA4-005/006/007 tasks are not closed.

items.title: PR005: classify whole sources and expose complete format eligibility coverage
items.body:
Repository text context can now distinguish whole-source eligibility from raw capture. New scans classify the full source before creating text items, so printable fragments from control-bearing or non-UTF8 files cannot appear as current text context. Exact UTF8, empty/BOM/CRLF/long lines and Python parse-failure fallback remain available. Strict three-line LFS pointers preserve declared payload metadata with availability NOT_CHECKED.

- Versioned source-bound facts in the existing repo_entries.analysis JSON; no replacement storage/runtime or total repository cap.
- Explicit stored-chunk backfill proves ranges, revisions, SHA256 and original SHA1/SHA256 Git OIDs, commits one source at a time, skips committed facts and blocks corruption.
- Shared current-source gates before search LIMIT, context_pack inclusion, selected/dependency export, review creation, report and handoff. Historical items/receipts remain intact.
- Read-only durable.repo.coverage SUMMARY/PAGE, ALL/GAPS, one SQLite read view, lossless decimal counts/ordinals, keyset scope and full 32768-byte frame budget.
- Safe coverage UI with all-page traversal, back/filter navigation, source choice gating and stale snapshot/repository/connection reply rejection.
- GAPS.jsonl is an explicit versioned metadata projection; PR002 raw manifest identities and PR003 portable raw ZIP formats remain unchanged. PR001 scan controls and PR004 streamed inventory are retained.

Validation: 437 local tests passed (266 Content Lab, 47 native bridge, 116 extension, 8 qualification adapter), plus focused final UI verification and git diff --check. All 18 roadmap acceptance scenarios have focused evidence. The 64-entry golden Native fixture yields 56 INDEXED / 6 EXCLUDED / 2 ERROR, 49 eligible / 15 gaps, with exact page union to EOF. Real Git/SQLite tests exercise large-source controls, interruption, corruption, split UTF8, concurrency, installed isolated siblings and manifest/ZIP reconstruction. Existing real 125000- and 160000-entry scale regressions passed.

Fresh actual-checkout qualification at local commit 164e547e2408b96c5e39db84266c274e7f89c424 (tree 2e4202724cdd28b5ada2208675f8725847d8e8a3): 310/310 entries accounted and fact-ready; 308 raw-captured and 298 text-eligible; all coverage pages complete (16 ALL pages, 1 GAPS page; max full frame 15497 bytes). Separate manifest proof PASS for all 308 INDEXED files, 1832 parts and 5515304 raw bytes. Two protected-text fixture entries remain excluded. Coverage counts themselves retain raw_integrity=NOT_RUN.

Base: 9fbadef2714fae92e516a80b52d29cb9824b0e44. Initial published code head: 052444be36d92e43a0c92c937283ff86b1bff79f; its tree exactly matches the locally tested implementation. Exact-head Ubuntu/Windows CI will be verified before merge.

[Runbook](docs/automation/pr005-format-eligibility.md) · [Complete new/changed function list](docs/automation/pr005-functions.md)

Installed Dell Windows 11/Chrome qualification remains NOT_RUN. LFS payload acquisition, additional encodings/derivative extractors, historical artifact requalification and full LAYA4-004/M5-02 are outside this slice. Per-invocation backfill and per-message transport budgets are adjustable/local budgets, not total corpus limits.

[Implementation receipt](docs/automation/runs/PR005_IMPLEMENTATION_RESULT_2026-10-04.json). Final published head: `4537c773a84474bcb613b3524494388d955552b9`; final tree `0ba9c3830d0780881d2334454e444ae33929dddd` equals the locally verified tree. All 66 fixture files were also compared byte-for-byte after checkout with core.autocrlf=true; the explicit PR005 -text attribute preserves them on Windows. Production classifier/gate/UI code is unchanged since the passing local suites. Full function inventory: **32 new functions and 16 changed functions**.

items.title: PR004: stage complete Git inventories with bounded memory and atomic publication
items.body:
Git inventory now stages a complete pinned Git tree on disk with bounded read/insert memory, then atomically publishes it to the existing SQLite owner. Default inventory has no total file-count, output-byte, runtime or stage-size ceiling. An operator can explicitly select a deadline or storage quota.

- Independent binary stdout/stderr drains, NUL-safe paths, SHA1/SHA256 metadata validation, bounded record/stderr guards, and verified process stop/reap/join.
- Exact stage readback and stream digest; malformed, duplicate, cancelled, failed-child and SQLite-full cases roll back without exposing a truncated successful snapshot. Storage quotas include target journal/WAL reserve.
- Existing snapshot identity is fully validated; captured states survive reuse. Native START shares inventory and scan-intent publication in one transaction and retains manifest capture retry behavior.
- Integrated with actual merged PR001 (#38), PR002 (#39) and PR003 (#40). All-page capture, manifest tail/range output, portable ZIP64 tail reconstruction and deterministic archive rebuild are verified. Installer contains all required adapter siblings.

Validation on the final integrated code: **416 local tests passed** (250 Content Lab, 46 bridge, 112 extension, 8 qualification adapter), plus `git diff --check`. A real 160000-entry tree emits 45600000 bytes and preserves every ordinal and the tail. All 4075 split boundaries of the supplied 55-record fixture pass. Tests include deadline, busy SQLite, backpressure, cancellation/restart, actual SQLITE_FULL, target-sidecar quota rollback, concurrent writers, atomic visibility and scan-intent rollback.

Linux cold/warm measurements at 40k/160k entries: application peak **21213184 bytes (~20.2 MiB)**; fourfold-corpus RSS growth **606208 bytes (~0.6 MiB)**; Git-child peak ~40.4 MiB; 160k stage ~167 MiB and observed stage/target/journal storage peak ~443 MiB. Cold means first new process; OS caches were not evicted. Warm validates/reuses the same snapshot in a second process.

Code commit: `1f6932baeac882a5da0b9dc0d32dc5fe8fcc4ddd`. Final head: `dc9f89e72cf547047de3345affb168c46caebb1a`; final tree `327b4cc0ec788ee940ce12286eafd6e3482954f4` matches the locally verified tree byte-for-byte. Exact-head Ubuntu and Windows GitHub Actions **passed**: [run 37198522717](https://github.com/BobIvans/scaling-chrome-extensions/actions/runs/37198522717).

Installed Dell Windows 11/Chrome/native-host resource qualification is still NOT_RUN. Physical CPU/RAM/disk limits and source eligibility remain applicable. This PR does not close the broader LAYA4-003/160-task roadmap.

[Runbook](docs/automation/pr004-streaming-inventory.md) · [Implementation receipt](docs/automation/runs/PR004_IMPLEMENTATION_RESULT_2026-10-04.json) · [Resource observations](docs/automation/runs/PR004_INVENTORY_RESOURCES_2026-10-04.json)

Windows CI exposed a retained SQLite SELECT cursor on metadata-error cleanup; explicit cursor close now releases the stage file before deletion, with a cross-platform handle regression. The first full Windows run also exhausted its previous 10-minute job budget after the 160k inventory passed; the full real-fixture suite now has 20 minutes. Corpus counts and application deadlines are unchanged. The failed run is preserved in the implementation receipt; updated exact-head CI passed on both Ubuntu and Windows.

Final CI evidence: Ubuntu ran 250 Python tests, 46 bridge tests, 8 adapter tests and 112 extension tests. Windows ran 250 Python tests (247 passed, 3 platform-specific skips), plus all 46 bridge, 8 adapter and 112 extension tests. The skips are two existing symlink-permission tests and the POSIX SIGINT test. Windows metadata-error and explicit stage-handle cleanup regressions passed, as did Native START on 125000 entries (38500000 Git-tree output bytes).

Merged into main as `9fbadef2714fae92e516a80b52d29cb9824b0e44` after both exact-head CI jobs succeeded.

items.title: PR003: verified full-context ZIP64 export with atomic resume
items.body:
Captured repository context can now be exported as one verified portable ZIP64 archive. Every INDEXED raw part is included, with binary and empty byte reconstruction, paged offline source/part navigation, and explicit gap metadata. There is no total file, part, page, or archive byte cap.

The foreground exporter binds the current operator profile and frozen manifest, stages parts with fsync/atomic replacement, holds a Windows/POSIX process lock, and rehashes parts on explicit resume. Interrupted ZIP assembly is rebuilt from staged parts. Final ZIP publication follows member/CRC/hash/Git OID reconstruction checks; external checksum/receipt sidecars are reconciled after a rename-before-receipt crash. Cancelled runs require explicit new-run; damaged final archives block without being overwritten.

Builds on merged PR-001 (#38) and PR-002 (#39). The PR-002 manifest module remains the sole format/writer/native metadata owner; a pure archive-input adapter verifies its exact frozen projection in a read-only consistent SQLite view, including text-item eligibility and identity. Adds a foreground scan-to-manifest wrapper and isolated installed CLI support. Existing Native INFO/ENTRIES/PARTS and scan-run controls are preserved. Install.ps1 includes the new modules.

Validation:
- Content/automation Python suite: 225 passed, including 22 new real SQLite/CLI and process fault tests.
- Native bridge: 46 passed; qualification adapter: 8 passed; extension: 112 passed.
- Scale qualification: all 66,000 captured parts exported into a valid 69,309-member ZIP64 archive; 112,005,120 bytes peak process RSS in the current-format qualification. Build took 47.282 seconds; resume reverified all parts and the archive in 23.38 seconds, reusing 66,000 parts and rewriting zero. This scale fixture is a synthetic captured SQLite ledger, not a Git scan or device benchmark.
- Tests cover subprocess death before/after part rename, during ZIP and after final rename; two writers; corruption; ENOSPC/EACCES; cancellation; profile revocation; moved offline links and hostile source metadata; installed isolated CLI; legacy regressions.
- git diff --check and module compilation pass. GitHub CI passed on Ubuntu and Windows for exact head e1082a739a575688afe88f4190b6fe813bffadc8: https://github.com/BobIvans/scaling-chrome-extensions/actions/runs/37195919260. Windows ran 225 Python tests with 3 platform-specific skips; Linux passed the full 225-test suite.

Scope: verified foreground raw archive slice LAYA4-010. Windows user-device browser opening, Dell performance, actual >4GiB run, Native/desktop scan-to-archive integration, semantic graphs and remaining roadmap tasks are still open. Native transport frame/deadline budgets remain per request; they are not expanded to carry an archive. Stdlib ZIP central-directory memory grows with member count.

Source input: ROADMAP_PR_003_PORTABLE_ZIP_ATOMIC_RESUME_RU_2026-10-04, SHA256 03517c11625ecacdc3c8f1d8b8feda13807c365bf0c8a86fbbbe7f1593d4e39f. Usage and scoped qualification receipt: docs/automation/roadmap-pr003-portable-archive.md and roadmap-pr003-implementation-result.json.

Merged into main as 3abd9e6b37d9a654ef96b03357b7f0a7301d85c2; the merged tree matches the tested source tree.

items.title: PR-002: complete repository manifest and byte-range index on the full-scan controller
items.body:
A completed full repository scan now exposes every tracked entry and captured chunk through a deterministic manifest and a bidirectional byte-range index. File/part page sizes do not cap repository coverage.

This change integrates merged PR-001 #38 (`426f60b`) and preserves its canonical streaming Git scanner, pause/continue/cancel controller, progress heartbeats and additive SQLite schema. Repository file count, blob bytes and streamed Git-tree output have no application hard cap. The AST workspace budget changes analysis scope without omitting captured bytes.

- Add repo_manifest.py: REPO_MANIFEST.jsonl, PARTS_INDEX.jsonl, VALIDATION.json and BATCH.json from one SQLite read view, with chunk/revision/text integrity and full SHA-256/Git blob OID reconstruction proof.
- Stage and atomically publish verified metadata directories; deterministic replay compares existing outputs and rejects damaged destinations.
- Add strict durable.repo.manifest INFO/ENTRIES/PARTS negotiation and paged UI navigation, including file → parts → source and guards against delayed replies from changed queries.
- Keep 20 rows / 32768 bytes per native frame with complete continuation. Reuse the full-scan heartbeat owner for metadata/byte iteration; add an explicit operator capture CLI and retry legacy FILE_TOO_LARGE entries on scan resume.

Validation on the integrated code: 203 Content Lab Python tests, 46 bridge tests, 112 extension tests and 8 qualification-adapter tests passed locally (369 total). Focused final checks also passed: 16 manifest tests and 12 repo/review UI tests, including full-scan controller → NativeClient → JobHost → isolated Python → SQLite → complete manifest/part navigation.

Scale evidence includes a real 125,000-file Git tree with 38,500,000 bytes of enumeration output, a blob above the former 8 MiB threshold, a 50-entry manifest fixture, >20 parts in one file, binary/UTF-8/CRLF/empty data, concurrent SQLite writes, historical snapshots, corruption mutations, and interruption/disk-full at every publication stage. Final integrated head `6ee2f4b38fdee8e2e6a70e9eddd0daefc40ac756` passed both Ubuntu and Windows in [run 37195080373](https://github.com/BobIvans/scaling-chrome-extensions/actions/runs/37195080373). The initial implementation also passed run 37194003590.

The metadata/range-index slice is complete. Full captured-payload ZIP recovery remains PR-003; LAYA4-009/M5-02 retain their goal/group/AI-packet scope. Installed Windows Chrome/native-host qualification remains a separate device receipt. See docs/automation/repo-manifest.md and docs/automation/runs/PR002_IMPLEMENTATION_RESULT_2026-10-04.json.

Final whole-repository projection: 214/214 tracked entries indexed, 1595 parts, 5,131,762 captured bytes; full reconstruction/Git blob OID proof PASS and all_tracked_bytes_exportable=true. Native ENTRIES (11 pages) and PARTS (80 pages) exactly match the full serialized indexes without missing tails.

items.title: PR001: stream whole repositories with durable scan controls
items.body:
Repositories with more than one page currently require repeated scan clicks, and Git output above 32 MiB or blobs above 8 MiB are rejected. This change makes “Собрать весь repo” pump every page automatically and replaces both size caps with streaming Git inventory/blob capture.

The existing SQLite owner now persists START/STATUS/STEP/PAUSE/CONTINUE/CANCEL runs with atomic cursor/revision guards, idempotent intents and page replay, cancelled-intent tombstones, source/profile checks and crash recovery. The UI keeps Pause/Stop available during a page, rejects stale replies and restores STATUS without automatically resuming. Transactional ledger counters and ordinal pagination avoid rescanning the inventory for every page. Trusted native progress extends idle watchdogs while individual native messages remain bounded.

20 entries is a page size, not a repository file limit. UTF-8/binary bytes are captured in exact fragments; large files disclose text-only parsing outside the 2 MiB AST window. Protected names, metadata exclusions and read failures remain explicit gaps. Legacy scan/get/export and database/review records remain compatible.

Validation: 349 local tests passed across all four required CI suites (187 Content Lab, 46 bridge, 8 qualification adapter, 108 extension). Includes the supplied 45-file corpus at cursors 20/40/45; full 2005-file processing; a 125000-entry inventory emitting 38500000 bytes; UTF-8/binary blobs above 8 MiB; an actual process exit before commit; and UI → installed native adapter → Git/SQLite restart with simulated reply loss after a real commit. The large-tree case qualifies inventory and cancels before processing all its blobs.

Published implementation tree matches the locally tested Git tree: a15959865763d752bd4179cf7e66a7bb797c442b. Final head dc3debed118ce4d51f94c802697d867b429d9f24 adds the evidence receipt. Windows 11 Dell installed-device qualification remains NOT_RUN; broader portable export/LFS/desktop milestones remain open. Update both extension and installed native host/adapters to use the new endpoint.

[Implemented capabilities and contract](https://github.com/BobIvans/scaling-chrome-extensions/blob/dc3debed118ce4d51f94c802697d867b429d9f24/docs/automation/roadmap-pr001-full-repo-scan.md)
[12-criterion implementation receipt](https://github.com/BobIvans/scaling-chrome-extensions/blob/dc3debed118ce4d51f94c802697d867b429d9f24/docs/automation/roadmap-pr001-implementation-result.json)

Implements ROADMAP-PR-001 with the current user's explicit amendment to remove repository/tree/blob size caps.
